name: The Tale of Gil-galad
game_text:
<keyword>Tale</keyword>. Bearer must be an Elf.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.
flavor_text: “Gil-galad was an Elven-king / Of him the harpers sadly sing: / the last whose realm was fair and free / between the Mountains and the Sea.”
